summary: Fix diff hunk line selection. Walk each text fragment's lines in order and track the new-file line position, so a hunk with more than one separated edit produces one Change range per added-line run instead of one range for the whole hunk. Make IsChanged distinguish a nil Diff (diff selection disabled, everything is changed) from a non-nil Diff with no matching range (diff selection enabled, nothing added at that position).
trust_boundaries: newChanges now walks fragment.Lines and tracks the new-file line position in memory instead of computing one range from aggregate hunk counts. IsChanged distinguishes a nil Diff from an empty, non-nil Diff. No package dependency, CLI flag, configuration key, report field, exit code, or network destination changes.
